Container.Overview:
Safely empties Plex library trash by validating mount health before acting. Supports multiple Plex instances, mixed physical/debrid libraries, per-library cron schedules, dry runs, and Discord notifications.
Use the built-in setup wizard at http://[IP]:8222 to configure your Plex instances and libraries — no manual config file editing required. Plex tokens, provider keys, notifications, auth, and schedules are saved through the web UI. Container variables below are optional overrides.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the emptyarr web interface and setup wizard.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent data directory. Stores config.yml and state.json. Create this directory before starting: mkdir -p /mnt/cache/appdata/emptyarr/data

Config.Name: Symlink Media Root
Config.Description: Root path containing your symlink media (debrid/usenet symlinks and mounts). Must use slave propagation so FUSE mounts (Decypharr, zurg, etc.) created after container start are visible inside. Mount the root folder — the wizard will let you select specific subfolders. The container path must match so symlink targets can resolve.

Config.Name: Physical Media Root
Config.Description: Root path containing your physical media files. Mount the root folder — the wizard will let you select specific subfolders.

Config.Name: Web UI Username (optional)
Config.Description: Optional environment override. Web authentication is normally configured in emptyarr Settings.

Config.Name: Web UI Password (optional)
Config.Description: Optional environment override. Only used when the username override is also set.

Config.Name: Plex Token (Instance 1)
Config.Description: Optional environment override. Plex sign-in and token storage are normally managed in the emptyarr UI.

Config.Name: Plex Token (Instance 2)
Config.Description: Optional environment override for a second Plex instance.

Config.Name: Real-Debrid API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional environment override. Provider keys are normally saved in emptyarr Settings.

Config.Name: Discord Webhook URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional environment override. Configure notifications in emptyarr Settings for normal use.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Your local timezone for accurate cron scheduling. Examples: America/New_York, America/Denver, Europe/London
